statements.statement: Article one would add to the amount raised and appropriated under article 7 of the May annual town meeting budget, split across reserve fund, salary reserve and town clerk salary.
Levy capacity balance remained at the end of annual town meeting and goes toward the additional appropriation.
State aid came in higher than the annual town meeting estimate after the state budget was finalized.
New growth revenue estimate raised to a conservative total from the annual town meeting figure.
Article three would fund the first year of the clerical collective bargaining agreement from the salary reserve.
